notes.title: DEATH STRANDING DIRECTOR’S CUT PC UPDATE – Intel® XeSS 1.1
notes.notes:
Porters, the latest update for DEATH STRANDING DIRECTOR’S CUT is out now on Steam. This update contains the following:


 XeSS v1.1 - Introduces improved temporal stability for XeSS DP4a and XMX models
 Reduced ghosting, moire and flickering
 DualSense Edge Support

Please note: Players will need to disable Steam Input and connect their controller with a USB C cable in order to use the full functionality of the DualSense Edge.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41741388/b73a24423ca521173063f5b0c33ae77f7316dc8f.jpg

notes.title: INTEL XESS UPDATE OUT NOW
notes.notes:
Exciting news! DEATH STRANDING DIRECTOR'S CUT users on PC can now experience Intel's all-new XeSS graphics technology as part of our latest update!

Intel's AI-enhanced upscaling technology will deliver ultra-high-definition visuals at performance levels of lower resolution rendering to create a more immersive experience for DEATH STRANDING DIRECTOR'S CUT. We can't wait for you to try it out for yourselves.

For more info on XeSS, head on over to the Intel website! 

Keep on keeping on!

notes.title: DEATH STRANDING DIRECTOR’S CUT PC COMMUNITY UPDATE
notes.notes:
Welcome back, Porters! Antonela here, Director of Global Community at 505 Games. In our latest Community Blog, we want to provide an update on all things DEATH STRANDING DIRECTOR’S CUT for PC, as promised.

Launching on Steam this Spring, DEATH STRANDING DIRECTOR’S CUT is the ultimate DEATH STRANDING experience. Ever since our initial announcement at the start of the month, the response from the community has been overwhelmingly positive. It was a fantastic way to kick off 2022, so firstly, we want to take this moment to say thank you for your love and support across our social channels. It really does mean a great deal to the team at KOJIMA PRODUCTIONS and 505 Games.

Looking forward, it’s now time to cover some of those burning questions you’ve been asking us. So, let’s get started.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41741388/d3844bfb252a6b09a7f90b25e8b65ae44de01052.jpg

RELEASE DATE
Earlier this month, we communicated Spring 2022 as our release window. Today we’re thrilled to announce that DEATH STRANDING DIRECTOR’S CUT will launch on Steam on March 30th, 2022. 

PRICING
DEATH STRANDING DIRECTOR’S CUT will cost the following at launch:
£34.99
€39.99
$39.99
4980 Japanese Yen
198 Chinese Yuan

https://505.games/SteamDSDCWishlist

UPGRADE OPTIONS
To those PC Porters who already own the base game of DEATH STRANDING, we’re giving you the opportunity to upgrade to DEATH STRANDING DIRECTOR’S CUT at launch. Pricing is as follows:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41741388/5f78ac5293d0deaf4be488bf5ba660e93bc13e87.jpg
 
Please note: To receive the upgrade for DEATH STRANDING DIRECTOR'S CUT you must have the DEATH STRANDING base game already installed on your PC. At launch, when you go through to purchase the game from the PC storefront, you will be presented with the upgrade price. If you do not have the DEATH STRANDING base game installed, then you will be presented with the full price.

PC SPECS
DEATH STRANDING DIRECTOR’S CUT PC’s minimum and recommended specs are as follows. 

MINIMUM:
OS: Windows® 10
Processor: Intel® Core™ i5-3470 or AMD Ryzen™ 3 1200
Memory: 8 GB RAM
Graphics: GeForce GTX 1050 4 GB or AMD Radeon™ RX 560 4 GB
DirectX: Version 12
Storage: 80 GB available space
Sound Card: DirectX compatible
Additional Notes: AVX instruction set required

RECOMMENDED:
OS: Windows® 10
Processor: Intel™ Core i7-3770 or AMD Ryzen™ 5 1600
Memory: 8 GB RAM
Graphics: GeForce GTX 1060 6 GB or AMD Radeon™ RX 590
DirectX: Version 12
Storage: 80 GB available space
Sound Card: DirectX compatible
Additional Notes: AVX instruction set required

ENJOY 70% OFF THE DEATH STRANDING BASE GAME FOR A LIMITED TIME
Not an existing owner yet? Don’t worry, we have some great news! For a limited time, as part of the Steam Lunar New Year sale, we’re heavily discounting the DEATH STRANDING base game on PC. If you’ve been on the fence for a while, now is the perfect opportunity to join us on the quest to reconnect America. Again, this is a limited time offer, so jump on it while you can.

https://505.games/SteamDSPCLunarSale22 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41741388/9ae92d2319ea6ce06e6dc54e7aeafbf0fa8823b9.jpg

GAME SAVE TRANSFER
For existing DEATH STRANDING players looking to upgrade to DEATH STRANDING DIRECTOR’S CUT at launch, we want to reassure you all that there’s nothing to worry about when it comes to your game save. There will be the option to transfer your progress and we’ll provide more information closer to launch. Stay tuned!

KEEP ON KEEPING ON
Hopefully this latest Community Blog covers a bunch of your burning questions, but we know you’ll have more as the days and weeks go on. We’ll do our very best to answer as many as we can before launch, so do keep them coming.

Let’s wrap up today’s blog by once again saying how much we appreciate you. Our PC Porters continuously motivate us with their continued show of support and encouragement. We’ve said it already, but it means the world to all involved on our side. The road ahead is looking super exciting, and we can’t wait for you to join us on this journey!

Stay tuned to the 505 Games and KOJIMA PRODUCTIONS social channels, official DEATH STRANDING PC website, as well as the DEATH STRANDING DIRECTOR’S CUT Steam page, for more info on upcoming community events and updates. We have some cool stuff planned for our Porters.

Stay safe and keep on keeping on!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41741388/b58025e1ef3ee80d548dbff8cbbaee9805de4a80.jpg
